passages.title: City Opens New Community Garden
passages.body:
Residents of the Eastside neighborhood can now grow their own vegetables at the new Linden Street Community Garden, which opened last Saturday. The garden, built on a former parking lot, contains 60 individual plots that can be rented for $40 per season.

“The demand has been overwhelming,” said city council member Rosa Delgado. “All the plots were reserved within three days, and we already have a waiting list of more than 100 people.”

The city plans to open two more gardens next year. Residents interested in volunteering or joining the waiting list can register at the Eastside Community Center.

passages.title: Now Hiring: Bilingual Customer Support Specialist — Polaris Travel Group
passages.body:
Polaris Travel Group, a leading provider of corporate travel services, is seeking a full-time customer support specialist for its Montreal office. Responsibilities include assisting clients by phone and e-mail, modifying bookings, and resolving billing issues.

Requirements:
- Fluency in English and French
- At least two years of customer service experience
- Familiarity with booking software is an advantage but not required; full training will be provided.

We offer a competitive salary, a hybrid work schedule (three days a week in the office), and discounted travel for employees and their families.

To apply, send your résumé and a cover letter to careers@polaristravel.com by October 15.

passages.title: Riverton Bike Maker Pedals Into Europe
passages.body:
RIVERTON (May 3) — Cyclo Works, a Riverton-based manufacturer of electric bicycles, announced on Tuesday that it will begin selling its products in Germany and the Netherlands this fall. [[1]]

The company was founded eight years ago by engineers Tomas Brandt and Ifeoma Nwosu, who started out repairing bicycles in a rented garage. Today, Cyclo Works employs 140 people and sold more than 25,000 bicycles last year. [[2]]

To support the expansion, the company has signed an agreement with a logistics firm in Rotterdam that will handle storage and deliveries throughout Europe. [[3]] Cyclo Works also plans to open a small customer service office in Berlin.

“European cyclists have high expectations,” said Ms. Nwosu. “We believe our long-lasting batteries will set us apart from the competition.” [[4]]

Dear Managers,

Beginning February 1, all expense reports must be submitted through our new online system, ExpensePro, rather than on paper. The system will allow us to process reimbursements in five business days instead of the current three weeks.

Training sessions on ExpensePro will be held at the regional office on January 20 and 22. Each session lasts two hours and is limited to 15 participants. If you cannot attend either session, a recording will be available on the intranet from January 23.

Please also note the following changes to the policy itself: meal expenses during business travel will now be reimbursed up to $60 per day (previously $50), and receipts are now required for all expenses over $10 (previously $25). Hotel bookings must still be made through our corporate travel agency.

Please share this information with your teams.

Sandra Kowalczyk

passages.title: Northern Retail Summit — October 9–10, Toronto Convention Centre
passages.body:
Registration: Full pass (both days) $420; one-day pass $250. Members of the Canadian Retail Association receive 20% off any pass.

Highlights:
Day 1 keynote — “The Future of Physical Stores,” Priya Raman, CEO of ShopLane
Day 2 workshop — “Data-Driven Pricing” (limited to 40 participants; registration required)

Hello,

I'd like to register for the full pass. I am a member of the Canadian Retail Association (membership number CRA-55821). I would also like to sign up for the workshop on data-driven pricing. Could you confirm whether the workshop is included in the pass?

Thank you,
Daniel Okoro
Store Operations Manager, Fenwick Home

Dear Mr. Okoro,

Thank you for registering. Your membership discount has been applied. The workshop is included in your pass, and we have reserved a place for you. Because of high demand, the workshop has been moved to a larger room (Hall C), and the number of places has been increased to 60.

Please also note that Ms. Raman will no longer be able to attend in person; she will deliver her keynote by video link.

Best regards,
Sylvie Gagnon

passages.title: AquaPure Home Water Filter — Model AP-3
passages.body:
Removes 99% of common contaminants.
Each filter cartridge lasts 6 months or 2,000 liters, whichever comes first.
Price: $89. Replacement cartridges: $25 each, or $20 each with an annual subscription.
Free shipping on orders over $50. Two-year warranty.

passages.title: ★★★☆☆ “Good filter, short cartridge life” — by K. Mensah, August 14
passages.body: I bought the AP-3 in May, and the water tastes much better. However, my first cartridge needed replacing after only two months. We are a family of five and use a lot of water for cooking, so maybe that's why. Also, replacement cartridges aren't cheap when you buy them one at a time. Overall, I'd recommend this filter, but be aware of the extra costs.

passages.title: Response from AquaPure Customer Care — August 15
passages.body: Thank you for your review, Mr. Mensah. You're right that larger households reach the 2,000-liter limit sooner. To help reduce your costs, we have added three months of free cartridges to your account; they will be shipped automatically with your next order. You may also be interested in our new Model AP-5, whose cartridge lasts twice as long.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To report a change in mall hours
questions.explanation: Le parking C sera fermé du 2 au 4 juin : c'est une fermeture temporaire.
questions.trap: Le nouveau parking d'Elm Street est mentionné, mais l'avis n'en fait pas la promotion.

questions.prompt: What is available from the parking garage?
questions.explanation: « A shuttle bus will run from the garage to the main entrance every 10 minutes ».
questions.trap: Aucun tarif réduit n'est annoncé.

questions.prompt: At 9:16 A.M., what does Mr. Haddad most likely mean when he writes, “My car's in the shop until Thursday”?
options: He will be late for work on Thursday.
He is buying a new car.
questions.explanation: Mme Ruiz lui demande d'apporter des cartons ; sa voiture étant au garage, il ne peut pas les transporter. Elle propose aussitôt une autre solution.
questions.trap: « in the shop » signifie « au garage », pas « au magasin ».

questions.prompt: What will Mr. Haddad do?
options: Leave some boxes near a door
Count the inventory again on Thursday
questions.explanation: « I'll leave them by the loading door. »
questions.trap: C'est Priya qui récupérera les cartons après son déjeuner.

questions.prompt: How much did Hallmark Accounting pay for delivery?
questions.explanation: La ligne « Delivery and assembly » est à 0 $ : livraison gratuite.
questions.trap: 1 500 $ est le seuil de gratuité, pas un montant facturé.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the order?
options: It qualified for a free service.
questions.explanation: Le total (1 620 $) dépasse 1 500 $ : la livraison et le montage sont offerts.
questions.trap: Il y a quatre chaises et deux bureaux, pas quatre bureaux ; le paiement est à 30 jours.

questions.prompt: Why was the e-mail sent?
options: To announce that check-in is available
To request payment for a ticket
questions.explanation: « Online check-in for your flight … is now open. »
questions.trap: Les bagages supplémentaires sont une information secondaire.

questions.prompt: How can Mr. Watanabe save money on extra luggage?
options: By purchasing it online in advance
By checking in at the airport
questions.explanation: Les bagages supplémentaires sont moins chers en ligne jusqu'à 6 heures avant le départ ; à l'aéroport, le plein tarif s'applique.
questions.trap: L'enregistrement à l'aéroport fait justement payer le plein tarif.

questions.prompt: What was the garden site previously used for?
questions.explanation: « built on a former parking lot ».
questions.trap: « former » (ancien) est la clé ; les autres usages ne sont pas mentionnés.

questions.prompt: In paragraph 2, the word “overwhelming” is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: « The demand has been overwhelming » : la demande a été considérable, comme le confirment les parcelles réservées en trois jours.
questions.trap: « overwhelming » peut signifier « accablant » dans d'autres contextes ; ici, le sens est « énorme ».

questions.prompt: How can residents join the waiting list?
options: By registering at a community center
questions.explanation: « can register at the Eastside Community Center ».
questions.trap: Les 40 $ sont le prix de location d'une parcelle, pas de l'inscription sur la liste d'attente.

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned as a job responsibility?
questions.explanation: Les missions citées : aider les clients par téléphone et e-mail, modifier les réservations, régler les problèmes de facturation. Former des employés n'en fait pas partie.
questions.trap: « full training will be provided » concerne la formation que le candidat recevra, pas une mission.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about experience with booking software?
options: At least two years of it are needed.
It is tested during the interview.
questions.explanation: « Familiarity with booking software is an advantage but not required ».
questions.trap: Les deux ans d'expérience concernent le service client, pas le logiciel.

questions.prompt: What benefit is offered?
questions.explanation: « discounted travel for employees and their families ».
questions.trap: Le poste est hybride (trois jours au bureau), pas entièrement à distance.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the letter?
questions.explanation: « Thank you for your interest… As you requested, I have attached a price list » : il répond à une demande d'information.
questions.trap: La réservation n'est pas encore confirmée : un acompte est exigé pour cela.

questions.prompt: What is mentioned about the meeting rooms?
questions.explanation: « each equipped with a projector and a video-conferencing system ».
questions.trap: 80 est la capacité totale du lodge, pas celle de chaque salle.

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? “Group rates are available for bookings of more than 30 guests.”
questions.explanation: La phrase parle de tarifs : elle suit naturellement la mention de la liste de prix, juste avant la règle de l'acompte.
questions.trap: La position [2] suit les salles de réunion et précède les loisirs : aucune question de prix à cet endroit.

questions.prompt: What problem does Ms. Cole report?
questions.explanation: L'imprimeur ne peut pas livrer avant vendredi, alors que la conférence commence jeudi.
questions.trap: « printer » désigne ici l'imprimeur (l'entreprise), pas une machine en panne.

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Tanaka suggest?
options: Using a different type of paper
questions.explanation: « Could they use a different paper? … matte instead of glossy. »
questions.trap: Elle précise que le design resterait le même.

questions.prompt: At 10:12, what does Mr. Sousa most likely mean when he writes, “That's a lot of pages”?
options: He thinks the brochure is too long.
He is pleased with the number of attendees.
He doubts that printing in the office is practical.
He wants to order more paper.
questions.explanation: Il réagit à l'idée d'imprimer au bureau : avec 240 participants, cela ferait énormément de pages. Il exprime un doute sur la faisabilité.
questions.trap: Il ne critique pas la longueur de la brochure elle-même.

questions.prompt: When will the brochures most likely be delivered?
questions.explanation: Mise à jour de 10 h 15 : l'imprimeur peut livrer mercredi après-midi sur papier mat.
questions.trap: Vendredi était la date initiale, abandonnée.

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: The opening of a factory in Germany
A company's plan to enter new markets
questions.explanation: Cyclo Works va vendre ses vélos en Allemagne et aux Pays-Bas : elle s'implante sur de nouveaux marchés.
questions.trap: Aucune usine n'est ouverte en Allemagne : seulement un bureau de service client à Berlin.

questions.prompt: According to the article, what did the founders originally do?
options: They worked for a logistics firm.
questions.explanation: « who started out repairing bicycles in a rented garage ».
questions.trap: Les batteries sont citées comme atout actuel, pas comme activité d'origine.

questions.prompt: What will the Rotterdam company most likely do?
questions.explanation: « a logistics firm in Rotterdam that will handle storage and deliveries throughout Europe ».
questions.trap: Le service client sera assuré par un bureau de Cyclo Works à Berlin.

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? “Nearly a third of those were sold outside the country.”
questions.explanation: « those » renvoie aux « 25,000 bicycles » vendus l'an dernier, mentionnés juste avant la position [2].
questions.trap: Placer la phrase en [1], où aucun nombre de vélos n'a encore été donné.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To introduce a new travel agency
To announce changes to an expense procedure
questions.explanation: Nouveau système en ligne et nouvelles règles de remboursement : l'e-mail annonce des changements de procédure.
questions.trap: L'agence de voyage reste la même (« must still be made through »).

questions.prompt: What is one benefit of ExpensePro?
questions.explanation: Remboursements en cinq jours ouvrés au lieu de trois semaines.
questions.trap: La numérisation automatique des reçus est plausible mais jamais mentionnée.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about managers who cannot attend a training session?
options: They must attend a session in February.
questions.explanation: « a recording will be available on the intranet from January 23 ».
questions.trap: Aucune session en février n'est prévue.

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned as a change?
options: A lower amount above which receipts are required
questions.explanation: Les réservations d'hôtel passent toujours par l'agence (« still ») : rien ne change. Les trois autres changements sont bien annoncés.
questions.trap: « receipts … over $10 (previously $25) » : le seuil baisse, ce qui correspond à l'option C.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about all the classes?
options: They are limited to four people.
questions.explanation: « All classes run from 10 A.M. to 1 P.M. and include lunch. »
questions.trap: « four » apparaît dans la remise de groupe, pas comme limite de participants.

questions.prompt: How much will each person in Ms. Benson's group most likely pay?
questions.explanation: Le 14 mars, c'est le cours marocain à 75 $. Ils sont quatre (elle et trois collègues), donc 10 % de remise : 75 × 0,9 = 67,50 $.
questions.trap: S'arrêter à 75 $ sans appliquer la remise de groupe annoncée dans le premier document.

questions.prompt: Why is Ms. Benson booking the class?
options: To prepare for a new job
questions.explanation: « We're planning it as a team-building activity. »
questions.trap: Les autres motifs sont plausibles mais absents du texte.

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Benson ask about?
options: Changing the date of the class
questions.explanation: « One of my colleagues is allergic to nuts. Could the recipes be adapted for her? »
questions.trap: Elle pose deux questions ; seule celle sur l'allergie figure parmi les options.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Ms. Benson's group?
options: They hope to stay after the scheduled end time.
They have taken a class before.
They plan to cancel their booking.
questions.explanation: Le cours se termine à 13 h (document 1) ; elle demande si la cuisine est disponible après 13 h (document 2).
questions.trap: Rien n'indique une participation antérieure à un cours.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To request feedback on a kitchen
To provide information about an office move
questions.explanation: Date du déménagement, attribution des bureaux, retard du 4e étage : l'e-mail informe sur le déménagement.
questions.trap: Les meubles sont mentionnés à cause d'un retard de livraison, pas d'une vente.

questions.prompt: Why will part of the new office not be ready on April 6?
options: Internet access has not been installed.
questions.explanation: « because of a delay in the delivery of furniture ».
questions.trap: Les autres causes sont fréquentes lors d'un déménagement mais ne sont pas citées.

questions.prompt: Which department will work from home until April 20?
questions.explanation: Le 4e étage ne sera prêt que le 20 avril (e-mail) ; le tableau y place le service juridique (Legal).
questions.trap: Le marketing est au 3e étage, près de la cuisine commune.

questions.prompt: According to the e-mail, what will all employees share?
questions.explanation: « The kitchen on the third floor will be shared by all employees. »
questions.trap: Aucun parking ni aucune salle de réunion n'est mentionné.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the marketing department?
options: It will move after the other departments.
It will share a floor with Finance.
It will be on the same floor as the shared kitchen.
It will work remotely for two weeks.
questions.explanation: Le marketing est au 3e étage (tableau), où se trouve la cuisine commune (e-mail).
questions.trap: Ce sont les services du 4e étage qui télétravaillent jusqu'au 20 avril.

questions.prompt: What is a requirement for the position?
questions.explanation: « Requirements: valid driver's license; ability to work at heights… »
questions.trap: La certification électrique est souhaitée (« preferred »), pas exigée, et elle ne figure pas dans les options.

questions.prompt: What hourly wage would Mr. Bell most likely receive if hired?
questions.explanation: M. Bell vient d'obtenir sa certification d'électricien (document 2) ; l'annonce prévoit 27 $ de l'heure pour les électriciens certifiés.
questions.trap: 24 $ est le salaire de base sans certification.

questions.prompt: What does Mr. Bell mention in his e-mail?
options: He lives near Phoenix Technical College.
He has installed solar panels before.
He can begin working right away.
He saw the job advertised in a newspaper.
questions.explanation: « I am available to start immediately. »
questions.trap: Son expérience porte sur des toitures (« roofing systems »), pas sur des panneaux solaires ; l'annonce était sur le site web.

questions.prompt: What is Mr. Bell asked to do for the interview?
questions.explanation: « please wear closed-toe shoes ».
questions.trap: L'épreuve pratique se fait sur place, sur une maquette de toit, pas en ligne.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the interview?
options: It will take place at a customer's home.
It will include a physical task.
It will be conducted by phone.
questions.explanation: « a short practical test on a rooftop model » : une épreuve pratique.
questions.trap: L'entretien a lieu au bureau de Phoenix, pas chez un client.

questions.prompt: How much did Mr. Okoro most likely pay for his registration?
questions.explanation: Pass complet à 420 $ (document 1), membre de l'association donc 20 % de remise, appliquée selon le document 3 : 420 × 0,8 = 336 $.
questions.trap: Oublier la remise membre, confirmée dans la réponse de Mme Gagnon.

questions.prompt: What does Mr. Okoro ask about?
options: Whether a workshop is included in a pass
How to become an association member
questions.explanation: « Could you confirm whether the workshop is included in the pass? »
questions.trap: Il est déjà membre : il donne son numéro d'adhérent.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about the workshop?
options: It will be held on the first day.
questions.explanation: Le nombre de places passe de 40 (document 1) à 60 (document 3).
questions.trap: L'atelier est inclus dans le pass : il ne coûte rien de plus.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Ms. Raman?
options: She is a member of the association.
questions.explanation: « she will deliver her keynote by video link » : elle interviendra à distance.
questions.trap: Fenwick Home est l'employeur de M. Okoro ; Mme Raman dirige ShopLane.

questions.prompt: In the third document, the word “demand” is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: « Because of high demand » : beaucoup de participants veulent s'inscrire, donc un fort intérêt.
questions.trap: « claim » (revendication) est un autre sens de « demand », qui ne convient pas ici.

questions.prompt: According to the product page, what comes with the AP-3?
questions.explanation: « Two-year warranty. »
questions.trap: L'abonnement annuel est une option payante pour les cartouches.

questions.prompt: Why did Mr. Mensah's cartridge most likely need replacing after two months?
options: His household reached the volume limit.
questions.explanation: La cartouche dure 6 mois OU 2 000 litres (document 1) ; famille de cinq qui utilise beaucoup d'eau (document 2) ; le fabricant confirme la limite des 2 000 litres (document 3).
questions.trap: Penser à un défaut, alors que les trois documents convergent vers la limite de volume.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Mr. Mensah?
options: He does not have an annual subscription.
questions.explanation: Il se plaint du prix des cartouches achetées une par une (25 $) ; avec l'abonnement annuel, il les paierait 20 $. Il n'est donc pas abonné.
questions.trap: L'AP-5 lui est seulement suggéré dans la réponse.

questions.prompt: What has AquaPure done for Mr. Mensah?
questions.explanation: « we have added three months of free cartridges to your account ».
questions.trap: L'AP-5 est seulement recommandé, pas offert.

questions.prompt: What does the response say about the AP-5?
questions.explanation: « whose cartridge lasts twice as long ».
questions.trap: Le prix de l'AP-5 n'est pas indiqué.
